core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khaleeq is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Worthy, deserving”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khaleeq corresponds to the Arabic form خليق (Arabic root خ ل ق (kh-l-q); خَلِيق (Khalīq)). Its core sense is worthy, deserving, fit. Khaleeq is Arabic خَلِيق (Khalīq) 'worthy, deserving', from the root خ ل ق (kh-l-q). The source gloss 'Creator, Maker' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as khaliq.
